name: sniptide
title: Sniptide
description: Search your Sniptide pastes and collections, paste or copy their code, and share your clipboard or selection as a link.
author: dino-kupinic

commands.name: search-pastes
commands.title: Search Pastes
commands.description: Search your pastes, then paste or copy their code or link.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does with the selected paste.

commands.name: search-collections
commands.title: Search Collections
commands.description: Find a collection and browse the pastes in it.

commands.name: create-paste
commands.title: Create Paste
commands.description: Create a paste from your selection or clipboard and choose its title, file name, visibility and collection.

commands.name: share-selection
commands.title: Share Selection
commands.description: Save the selected text as a paste and copy its link.

commands.name: share-clipboard
commands.title: Share Clipboard
commands.description: Save the clipboard's text as a paste and copy its link.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: A token from Settings > API tokens in Sniptide. Searching needs read access, and creating pastes needs write access.

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance Address
preferences.description: The address of your Sniptide instance. Change it only when you self-host.

preferences.name: defaultVisibility
preferences.title: Visibility for New Pastes
preferences.description: Who can open a paste created from Raycast. Share Selection and Share Clipboard always use it.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && eslint src test && prettier --check . && bun test ./test && ray build --non-interactive
